scripts.text:
[Derek Shot]
Are you unable to participate in battle because of clothing buffs? It has to be annoying.
scripts.translation:
[德里克·肖特]
是因为服装增益效果而无法参战吗？这确实很烦人。

scripts.text:
[Derek Shot]
While it looks good on you, it can also get really annoying. I can get rid of it with a single hand gesture!! I will arrange it neatly. If you are ready, choose your option!
scripts.translation:
[德里克·肖特]
虽然穿起来很好看，但确实很碍事。我只要一个手势就能帮你解除！我会帮你整理好的。准备好了就请选择选项吧！

scripts.text:
[Derek Shot]
Come back to me, if you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[德里克·肖特]
如果您改变主意，随时可以回来找我。

scripts.text:
[Derek Shot]
Removal has been completed. Make sure you can move freely now.
scripts.translation:
[德里克·肖特]
解除完成。请确认您现在可以自由行动了。
